description: Every leave request needs the direct manager
More than 3 business days also needs the manager's manager
More than 10 business days also needs the HR head
Unpaid leave always needs the HR head
Every expense claim needs the direct manager
Claim total above 500 USD also needs the manager's manager
Client entertainment always needs the manager's manager
Claim total above 2000 USD also needs the finance controller
A line above its policy limit needs the finance controller (exception path)
DE/UK claims above 1000 USD need the finance controller
Claim total above 10000 USD also needs the CFO
A claim that pushes its cost centre over budget needs the CFO
